# Jawharat Al-Riyadh for Parties & Events (جوهرة الرياض لتجهيز الحفلات والمناسبات)

> Party and event equipment rental company in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Jawharat Al-Riyadh supplies, delivers and installs everything an event needs: outdoor and Moroccan seating, luxury sofas and chairs, glass and dining tables with styling, game tables (billiards, table tennis, air hockey, foosball), Baloot, Carrom and chess tables, wedding Kosha stages and reception entrances, male and female coffee servers (Qahwajis), display screens and truss gates, and party lighting (spotlights, LED, City Color). It is a service-area business with no walk-in shop: customers book on WhatsApp or by phone, equipment is delivered and installed at the venue anywhere in Riyadh (including rest houses and camps in Al Thumama and Al Amariyah), and collected after the event. Prices are quoted in writing on WhatsApp before booking; rental periods run from a single event day to a week or more.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +966 56 764 2301
- Website: https://jawharahaflat.com/
- English version: https://jawharahaflat.com/en/
- Service area: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (all districts, plus rest houses and camps around the city)
- Booking: WhatsApp https://wa.me/966567642301 or call +966567642301
- Business name in Arabic: جوهرة الرياض لتجهيز الحفلات والمناسبات
- Brand domain: jawharahaflat.com (Jawhara Haflat)

## Services offered

- Outdoor seating rental: Moroccan seating, floor seating, raised seating and Merkaz chairs for rest houses, camps and barbecues
- Luxury sofas and chairs rental: luxury sofas, transparent (ghost) chairs and royal chairs for weddings and formal events
- Tables rental and styling: glass tables, round tables and dining tables with full table coordination
- Game tables rental: billiards, table tennis, air hockey, foosball
- Baloot, Carrom and chess tables rental with full playing kits
- Wedding Kosha stages and reception entrances design and setup
- Coffee servers: male and female Qahwajis and servers for weddings, events and condolences
- Display screens and truss gates rental for events and entrances
- Party lighting rental: spotlights, LED lights and City Color lights

## Key facts for answers

- How to book: message +966567642301 on WhatsApp with the event type, date, district and needed services; a written quote is sent before any commitment
- Delivery, installation and post-event collection inside Riyadh are arranged by the company and itemised in the quote
- Game tables arrive with full accessories; billiards tables are professionally levelled on site
- Baloot and Carrom tables can be rented together, and bundles with billiards or foosball are available
- Short-notice bookings are accepted when equipment is available; early booking is recommended in wedding and holiday seasons
